## Overview

This backward-compatible release adds the MarkdStage Visual Studio Code extension. It is a thin
wrapper over an installed MarkdStage CLI (npm or Windows packaged CLI) that previews, presents,
and validates the current Markdown deck, opens the Architecture Editor in a VS Code tab, and
installs or checks the generated GitHub Copilot Skill. The CLI continues to own parsing,
rendering, validation, workspace security, and Skill generation.

The extension is published to the Visual Studio Marketplace as `okazuki.markdstage-vscode` and
is also attached to this release as a VSIX. The packaged Windows CLI's local server now provides
the presenter window and PDF/PowerPoint export, matching the npm CLI, and the shared renderer no
longer clips slides at the right edge when a scrollbar is shown.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible. Existing Markdown decks, Canvas Extension installations,
npm CLI, and Desktop installations continue to work. The VS Code extension is optional and
requires MarkdStage CLI 4.4.0 or later within major version 4 in the environment
that runs the VS Code extension host, including remote workspaces. VS Code Web is not supported.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.4.0`. |
| VS Code | Optionally install `okazuki.markdstage-vscode` from the Marketplace or the release VSIX, then install MarkdStage CLI 4.4.0 or later where the extension host runs. |
| Architecture Editor CLI option | `--architecture-editor-target window\|same\|host` is new and optional; the default behavior is unchanged. |
